summary: Frontend-only testing of the new InfoTip (ⓘ) rollout across admin pages plus improved chart captions. Logged in as admin (email toggle) and verified info-tip counts, hover-reveal behaviour, the critical no-navigation-on-click behaviour, and no new JS errors. All feature checkpoints from the request pass. No regressions detected.

/admin/dashboard.sample_tooltip_text: A live snapshot of who is on campus and what needs action right now.

critical_regression_check: CRITICAL scenario passed: on /admin/dashboard the ⓘ button inside a Link-wrapped stat tile was clicked and page.url remained /admin/dashboard. InfoTip's onClick={preventDefault+stopPropagation} works as designed.
console_and_errors: 0 pageerrors across all tested pages. Only pre-existing Recharts container-width warnings during transient render (not introduced by this change).
critical_code_review_comments: InfoTip.jsx: creates a new TooltipProvider per icon. That is intentional per comment, but if a page has many icons (dashboard has 18) it adds provider overhead; acceptable trade-off but consider a single root provider later.
Recharts pages emit many 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings on first paint (pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration) — worth cleaning up later by giving chart containers a fixed height.
test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (via 'Admin sign in with email' toggle)
context_for_next_testing_agent: InfoTip component lives at frontend/src/components/InfoTip.jsx with data-testid='info-tip' or 'info-tip-<id>'. Radix tooltip opens on hover (desktop) and on focus (touch). Confirmed pattern for testing: query [data-testid^='info-tip'], hover -> [role='tooltip'] appears, click -> URL unchanged. DAR report route is /admin/dar (not /admin/dar-report).
